rationale: The assistant reached the correct conclusion matching the hidden truth: heat pump dryers run cooler and longer, and with clean filters and fully dry clothes there is no fault. It sensibly checked filters and dryness before reassuring. However, it ignored the customer's own mention of opening the door to check mid-cycle and never asked about room temperature or washer spin speed, so it missed the chance to explain why cycles are at the long end (8-10 C garage, door opening) and offer practical ways to shorten them. It also did not mention that Bosch warranty is the route if the drum never warms or clothes stay damp.
